completion_meaning: Recorded comparability checks passed; no performance threshold or SOTA claim is applied.
scope: Source-paired development evidence, not a frozen-test or omni generalization result.

factors.encoder: native_g05 minus legacy_g05; same 3000-step budget and guard 0.5
factors.guard: native_g20 minus native_g05; same native encoder and budget, guard 2.0 versus 0.5
factors.calibration: frozen_confidence versus its native_g05 parent; fidelity must remain fixed

comparability.flow_support: Recorded pairs/valid_pairs/valid_coverage exactly match; flow mask pixels have no hash and are not independently verified.
comparability.chunk_scope: Recorded ordinary task batch-1/batch-2 checks; controls have no separate chunk check.

temporal_interpretation.note: Pairs are 4 frames apart; adjacent-frame flicker is not evaluated. Candidate needs stride-1 follow-up.

frozen_fidelity_check.meaning: Identical recorded fidelity state SHA and numerically agreeing RGB metrics; no RGB benefit attributed to calibration. Metric agreement is not a pixel-array identity test.

sr.interpretation: Calibration diagnostic; no confidence weighting of RGB quality metrics.

deblur.interpretation: Calibration diagnostic; no confidence weighting of RGB quality metrics.

denoise.interpretation: Calibration diagnostic; no confidence weighting of RGB quality metrics.

compression.interpretation: Calibration diagnostic; no confidence weighting of RGB quality metrics.

metric_contract.rgb: float32 clipped [0,1], no prediction quantization; original recording RGB proxy
metric_contract.baseline: SR: torch bicubic antialias=True align_corners=False; native tasks: observed RGB identity
metric_contract.psnr: mean per-frame RGB PSNR, unit peak; exact-zero MSE capped at 120 dB
metric_contract.aggregation: windows averaged within source, then equal source weights; controls excluded from task scores
metric_contract.temporal: selected frame pairs t,t+frame_stride; full RGB error-change, no x4 band/physical-null claim
metric_contract.calibration: raw unclamped RGB errors, separate from quality metrics; nominal Gaussian coverage is a diagnostic
metric_contract.causal_context: original consecutive frames t-2..t with first-frame repetition
metric_contract.control_inputs: explicit identity and sigma=1/255 near-clean RGB controls from target; never ordinary dev input
metric_contract.comparison_limit: development ablations, not an untouched generalization test
